short_description.text: Ohad — son of Simeon (GEN 46:10). Of the tribe of Simeon.
Shiphrah — Hebrew midwife of Exodus (EXO 1:15).
Puah — Hebrew midwife of Exodus (EXO 1:15).
Reuel — Moses' father-in-law (EXO 2:18, NUM 10:29).
Zipporah — daughter of Reuel (EXO 2:18), Moses' wife (EXO 2:21), a Cushite (NUM 12:1).
Jochebed — aunt and wife of Amram, mother of Moses (EXO 6:20). Of the tribe of Levi.
Nepheg — son of Izhar (EXO 6:21). Of the tribe of Levi.
Zichri — son of Izhar (EXO 6:21). Of the tribe of Levi.
Mishael — son of Uzziel (EXO 6:22). Of the tribe of Levi.
Sithri — son of Uzziel (EXO 6:22). Of the tribe of Levi.
Elisheba — wife of Aaron and daughter of Amminadab (EXO 6:23). Of the tribe of Judah.
Elkanah — son of Korah (EXO 6:24). Of the tribe of Levi.
Putiel — father of Eleazar's wife (EXO 6:25).
Oholiab — appointed by G-d to the construction of the tabernacle (EXO 31:6). Of the tribe of Dan.
Ahisamach — father of Oholiab (EXO 31:6). Of the tribe of Dan.

when.text: The exodus is commonly dated around the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries BC; the dating is disputed.

what.text: God rescues Israel from slavery in Egypt through Moses, forms them as a covenant people at Sinai, and gives the tabernacle and its laws. Genre: Narrative and law.

before.text: Continues Genesis, where Jacob's family settled in Egypt.

stakes.text: Defines God's redemption of Israel, the covenant, the law and God's dwelling with his people.
